notes.title: Rocketbirds 2 Evolution Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch 1.02 is Live
The following are fixes and changes for this patch.

Multiplayer:

  Fixed a possible crash bug in online co-op.
  Fixed an issue which could cause the game to run in double speed in online co-op.
  Shotgun ammo crate in weapon shops now gives 25 ammo for $100 instead of 50.
  Fixed an issue with multiple steam controllers working in local co-op.

Gameplay

  Player shields' (tbr) are capable of blocking full damage from explosions and half of stability damage capped at half the player's total stability.

Note for steamlink users with Xbox/DS4 controllers: For controllers to work properly - turn on respective controller configuration support in Steam big picture settings.

notes.title: Rocketbirds 2 Evolution Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Patch 1.01 is Live
Please allow your game to update, especially if you intend to play online. Shout-out to all those who provided us with feedback and details which aided us in identifying issues, thank you. Changes include:

Multiplayer:

Fixed frequent desyncs(loading screen) issues in Online Co-op. The frequency of desyncs have been significantly reduced.
Fixed an issue where refreshing the join page will sometimes bring you back to the online root page.
General optimizations, frame-rate should improve slightly.
Various stability fixes


Gameplay:

Plasma Ammo quantity in the Hub increased from 100 to 500 in the vending   machines and 20 to 100 in the boxes.
Fixed an issue where the Hub elevator could get stuck in a state where it doesn't respond to the button.
Fixed a potential issue where you could get stuck waiting for the train when revisiting the tutorial from the Hub.
